title: Filtro de Realidad v5 + Anti-Sycophancy: A model-agnostic conduct protocol for AI coding assistants
description: A model-agnostic, citable conduct protocol for AI coding assistants and agent swarms: anti-sycophancy in both directions, verify-before-asserting reality filtering, and state-verification-over-authority for orchestrator/subordinate agent topologies. Includes a canonical PROTOCOL.md, adapters for Claude Code, Cursor, Antigravity, Kimi and GitHub Copilot, installable domain skills (Gemini CLI), executable validation harnesses for the artifact-layer and peer-verification rules, and a worked example from a multi-agent swarm building a machine-learning software application.
